description: The steps of the hospital-visit journey (USER_FLOWS.md section 3). The Demo guide panel shows them. npm run check:demo checks the user keys and the pages.

steps.title: The 3MT slide (Patient A)

actions: In the Care Assistant, ask: "Is she allergic to penicillin?"
You can also open the past chat of Oct 29, 2026.

expected: The answer is: "No. A physician ruled it out with an allergy test on Oct 2, 2026."
The card shows the current assertion.
Below it, the card shows two superseded assertions with a line through them, oldest first: "Front desk, 2019: penicillin allergy" and "Other clinic, 2024: penicillin allergy (copied)".

steps.title: Arrival (front desk)

actions: Find Patient B by name and date of birth. The app fills in the search. Open the patient.
Select Edit details. Change the phone number. Select Save. (UPDATE)
In "Check in a visit", select the class Emergency and the location "ER Waiting". Select Check in.
Add Priya Nair and Dr. Amara Okafor. Select "Save the care team".
Add Jun Park by mistake. Select "Save the care team".
Remove Jun Park. Select "Save the care team".
Select "Write an intake note". Write the statement: "Shortness of breath since this morning." Select Record.

expected: The visit is open in "ER Waiting".
The care team has Priya Nair and Dr. Amara Okafor only.
The care-team chain shows three versions: {Nair, Okafor} ← {Nair, Okafor, Park} ← {Nair, Okafor}. Sofia Alvarez is the author of each version.
The intake note is an observation (chief complaint) in the open visit.

steps.title: Waiting room (Patient B)

actions: In the Care Assistant, ask: "What medications am I taking?"
In My record, find the metformin item. Select Report. Write: "I stopped taking metformin." Select Record.

expected: The answer lists metformin.
The report is a new assertion about the metformin item. Its message has no staff issuer. Its origin is "Patient" and its channel is "App".
The report supersedes the metformin prescription. The chain is: prescription ← patient report.

steps.title: Triage (nurse)

actions: Open Patient B from My patients.
Read the earlier visits.
Open the Chart tab. Select "Record vital signs". Write the heart rate, the blood pressure and the oxygen saturation. Select Record.
Select Record. Select the category Diagnosis and the preset for an asthma attack. Select the intent Recommendation and the verification Provisional. Write the statement: "Possible asthma attack."
Select Record. Select the category Prescription and the preset for the salbutamol inhaler. Select the intent Recommendation.
Open the Visit tab. Move the patient to "ER Bed 2".
In the Care Assistant, ask: "Any allergies?"

expected: The chart shows the new items. The nurse is the author.
Patient B has no allergy on record. The answer says that no allergy is recorded, and it cites no item.

steps.title: Physician (doctor)

actions: In the Care Assistant, ask: "What did the nurse recommend?"
Select Record. Select the category Lab order and the troponin preset. Select Record.
Select Record again. Record the troponin result (category Lab result or Observation, troponin preset).
On the asthma item, select Supersede. Select the preset for heart failure. Select the intent Decision. Write: "Possible heart failure."
In the Care Assistant, tell: "The patient's father died of a heart attack."
On the new family-history item (Agent, Unconfirmed), select Confirm.
On the inhaler item, select Supersede. Select the furosemide preset. Select the intent Decision.
On the metformin item, select Supersede. Set the status to "stopped". Select the intent Decision. Write: "Metformin is stopped."

expected: The answer cites the nurse's recommendations.
The lab order and the lab result show in the chart.
The chain shows: asthma (superseded) ← heart failure.
The agent records the family history as unconfirmed. The source is "Agent". The card shows "Recorded, unconfirmed".
The doctor's confirmation supersedes the agent's item.
The chain shows: inhaler (superseded) ← furosemide.
The metformin chain shows: prescription ← patient report ← doctor decision.

steps.title: Transfer (nurse and front desk)

actions: Move the patient to "Cardiology Room 401".
Add Tom Becker. Select "Save the care team". This makes a new care-team entry that supersedes the earlier one.
Look at the chart of Patient B as Tom Becker.

expected: The visit shows each location with its times.
Tom Becker can open the chart.

steps.title: Evening (Patient B)

actions: In the Care Assistant, ask: "What is my plan?"

expected: The answer gives the heart-failure work-up and furosemide.
The answer does not give asthma or the inhaler.
The cards show the current items only. A patient sees no superseded rows.

steps.title: Privacy check (nurse not on the care team)

actions: Find Patient B. Open the patient.
Look at the Chart tab.
Look at the audit log.

expected: A 403 panel shows: "You are not on this patient's care team. This attempt is in the audit log."
Patient B sees the denied attempt (a red row) in the Audit tab.

steps.title: Directory (front desk)

actions: On the Staff tab, find a staff member. Select Edit. Change the phone number. Select Save. (UPDATE)
On the Departments tab, select Delete on Emergency. Select Delete in the dialog.
On the Locations tab, select Delete on "Old Storage Room". Select Delete in the dialog. (DELETE)

expected: The new phone number shows.
A 409 message shows: the department has staff, so you cannot delete it.
The location goes away from the list.

steps.title: Discharge (doctor)

actions: Select "End the visit". Select "End the visit" again in the dialog.

expected: The visit shows an end time.
The chart keeps the full history, with the author of each item. Select "Show history" on the Chart tab to see it.
